title: adhatoda oreophila
intro: Adhatoda oreophila, commonly known as Ghrita kumari, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating various respiratory issues, such as coughs, colds, and bronchitis, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda oreophila include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its ability to reduce fever and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its composition.
